title: Vertex AI with API key ignores GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION and uses the global endpoint (data residency)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed and actionable bug report explaining that Vertex AI with an API key ignores GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION and routes to the global endpoint. It includes version info, reproduction details, and reference to the underlying code in contentGenerator.ts.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix requires a localized logic update in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts to construct regional Vertex AI endpoints from GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION, alongside unit tests in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.test.ts.

summary.problem: When using Vertex AI authentication with an API key, setting GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION to a specific region (e.g., europe-west3) is ignored and requests default to the global endpoint https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/.
summary.root_cause: In packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts, createContentGenerator only sets baseUrl for 'us' or 'eu' multi-region locations. For regional locations, baseUrl remains undefined, causing @google/genai to default to the global endpoint.
summary.context: Data residency guarantees in Vertex AI require routing requests to regional endpoints matching GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION (https://${location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com).

steps: In packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.ts, locate the AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI section in createContentGenerator where baseUrl is set based on GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION.
Add a fallback clause for non-empty location strings to set baseUrl to 'https://${location}-aiplatform.googleapis.com'.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION is set to a region like 'europe-west3', createContentGenerator passes httpOptions.baseUrl = 'https://europe-west3-aiplatform.googleapis.com' to GoogleGenAI.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/core/src/core/contentGenerator.test.ts for AuthType.USE_VERTEX_AI when GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION is 'europe-west3'.
Verify that GoogleGenAI is called with httpOptions.baseUrl set to 'https://europe-west3-aiplatform.googleapis.com'.
